messages:
mira-sales: ACME-Health asked for final commit sizing + burst plan for their pilot next week. They sent traffic: steady 200 RPS gen, short spikes to 2.2k RPS for ~6-9m, avg 260 tokens. p95 target 300ms.
tom-se: quick Q: single model or multi-model? batching assumptions change numbers.
mira-sales: multi-model mix: 65% long chat (~2k ctx), 20% medium, 15% embeddings/rerank. Spikes from webhook fanout.
li-ml: back-of-envelope: quantized chat + KV caching (~35% hit) gives ~190-220 RPS per A100-eq node steady. For 2.2k peak plan for ~12 warm nodes, but streaming and long-ctx reduce batching so add headroom.
raj-fin: need two proposal tiers (economy p95 vs guaranteed p99) with baseline GPUs + burst cap. Numbers?
tom-se: propose: economy (p95): baseline 14 reserved, burst to 36 (burst pool mix spot+on-demand). guaranteed (p99): baseline 20 reserved, burst to 40, cross-AZ. Include preheat min_warm == baseline.
li-ml: recommend preheat window 8-10 minutes and a short perf smoke (5m ramp, hold 8m) as acceptance criteria.
ops-bot: reserve-intent-46221 logged for 14->36 (pending finance).
raj-fin: I'll price both options and share spreadsheet in ~60m.
mira-sales: I'll draft PO with autoscale snippet and preheat guarantees, schedule sign-off call tomorrow 9am PT.
li-ml: add note: Dedicated customers get tenant-isolated preheat; mention KMS + encrypted audit logs for preheat ops.
mira-sales: thanks team :thumbsup:
